_comment: Extension -> colourspace the Interpret passes assume when the file itself says nothing. Edited via the minColor shell. ORDER (2026-09-10): previously assigned, then AE-detected metadata, then this row, then skipped - every row is the fallback tier, never an override of a tagged file. 'working' means identity/no effect; a name equal to the preset's working space is identity too (so 'Linear Rec.709' is a no-op in a Linear Rec.709 project and a real transform elsewhere). Container rows name the Linear-family 709 video space; the Display family maps it to Rec.1886 through the legacy table. Unlisted extensions are skipped and reported, never guessed. The AEGP merges NEW rows from this seed into an existing settings table at launch and records them under 'seeded' so a deleted row stays deleted.
